name: Rule B2
status: FROZEN FOR FRESH VALIDATION - not implemented in the repo
source: Rule B (RULE_B.json sha256 e5ca57a721260ced10b7773a8a751bb197f2b2302ad68c12683e52e996466808, ruleB-frozen.mjs sha256 b36764af96f89b8d7d26b6803b9e4058377bf9eb8fe52ce00ea0edb97adacafd) plus predicate 7b; reference implementation ruleB2-frozen.mjs
precedence: Where the prose of DECISION.md and the measured predicate differ in wording, the measured predicate (this file, ruleB-frozen.mjs) governs. Known wording differences are listed under 'clarificationsOfDecisionProse'.
units: pdf.js user-space units as delivered by getTextContent(): transform[4] = x, transform[5] = baseline y, width; font size em = |transform[0]| or, if that is 0, |transform[3]|

rounding.segmentGeometry: x0, x1, y, em, firstEm, lastEm are rounded to 0.1 unit (Math.round(v*10)/10) when the segment is built
rounding.ratios: dyEm, pitchDev, dx0Em, emRatio, rightGapEm, fitGapEm are rounded to 2 decimals (Number(v.toFixed(2))) before comparison

v1Base.itemText: String(item.str ?? '') when item is an object with a 'str' key, else ''
v1Base.itemGeometry: left = transform[4]; baseline = transform[5]; right = left + width; em = |transform[0]| || |transform[3]|; null when any is not finite or em <= 0
v1Base.glue: two consecutive items are concatenated with '' when |baselineDiff| < 0.15*max(em) AND |next.left - prev.right| < 0.15*max(em); otherwise with ' '

segments.definition: consecutive items in pdf.js emission order, closed by an item whose hasEOL is true; a run whose joined text is only white space is not a segment (its text is carried as separator of the next segment)
segments.text: exactly the v1 join of the segment's items
segments.ink: items with non-blank text and non-null itemGeometry; a segment with no ink item takes no part in the rule

fields.y: baseline of the widest ink item
fields.em: em of the widest ink item
fields.rot: true when any ink item has |transform[1]| > 1e-6 or |transform[2]| > 1e-6

printedLines.definition: segment i continues the printed line of segment i-1 (same page) when |y_i - y_(i-1)| <= 0.35*max(em_i, em_(i-1)) AND x0_i >= x1_(i-1) - 0.5*em_i
printedLines.gx0: min x0 over the segments of the printed line
printedLines.gx1: max x1 over the segments of the printed line

pageLinePitch.samples: for consecutive segments i, i+1 of the page: dy = y_i - y_(i+1), kept when dy > 0 AND |x0_i - x0_(i+1)| < 3*em_i AND dy < 3*em_i
pageLinePitch.value: the element at index floor(n/2) of the ascending-sorted samples; null when there are none

evidence.builtFrom: the ORIGINAL unrepaired segment texts of every extracted page, once, before any decision; never updated
exclusions: if the right-trimmed segment text ends with <letter run><hyphen-like>, its last white-space-delimited token is removed before counting
if the previous segment ON THE SAME PAGE ends that way, the first white-space-delimited token of this segment is removed before counting
evidence.tokenisation: lower-cased text; every match of \p{L}+(?:[-\u2010\u2011]\p{L}+)* ; split at '-', U+2010, U+2011 into parts
evidence.pairs: count of every adjacent pair 'part_k-part_(k+1)' (joined with U+002D)

candidateSite.A_B: segment A and the next segment B in emission order ON THE SAME PAGE
candidateSite.endMatch: (\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*)([hyphen-like])$ on a  ->  L = group 1, hy = group 2

predicatesAllRequired.name: same-page
predicatesAllRequired.test: A and B are consecutive segments of one page; a page-boundary pair is never joined

predicatesAllRequired.name: hyphen-is-U+002D
predicatesAllRequired.test: hy === U+002D (HYPHEN-MINUS). U+00AD, U+2010, U+2011, U+2012, U+2013, U+2014, U+2212 never qualify

predicatesAllRequired.name: lowercase-at-break
predicatesAllRequired.test: last character of L matches \p{Ll} AND first character of R matches \p{Ll}

predicatesAllRequired.name: left-token-shape
predicatesAllRequired.test: (?:^|\s)[\p{Ps}\p{Pi}"']*(\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*)-$ matches ' ' + tokL  (opening punctuation or quotes, letters, one final hyphen; no digit, slash, inner hyphen or dash)

predicatesAllRequired.name: right-token-shape
predicatesAllRequired.test: ^(\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*)(?=$|\s|[\p{Pe}\p{Pf}.,;:!?"']) matches tokR  (letters, then end, white space or closing punctuation; not a hyphen, digit or slash)

predicatesAllRequired.name: no-url-structure
predicatesAllRequired.test: NOT ( URL_STRUCTURE matches tokL OR URL_STRUCTURE matches tokR ), where URL_STRUCTURE = [/@]|[.:][\p{L}\p{N}]

predicatesAllRequired.name: upright-not-rtl
predicatesAllRequired.test: A.rot is false AND B.rot is false AND A.lastDir !== 'rtl' AND B.firstDir !== 'rtl'

predicatesAllRequired.name: next-line-below-at-body-pitch
predicatesAllRequired.test: dyEm = (A.y - B.y)/em;  dyEm > 0.5 AND dyEm <= 4 AND ( dyEm <= 2.6 OR ( pitch !== null AND |(A.y - B.y) - pitch| / pitch <= 0.25 ) )

predicatesAllRequired.name: same-column
predicatesAllRequired.test: dx0Em = (gx0(B) - gx0(A))/em;  -6 <= dx0Em <= 3 AND gx0(B) < A.x1

predicatesAllRequired.name: right-edge-would-not-fit
predicatesAllRequired.test: neighbours = segments j within i-6..i+6 on the page, not rot, with |gx0(j) - gx0(A)| <= 3*em AND |y_j - A.y| <= 10*em (A itself included for the maximum); blockRight = max gx1 over them; neigh = number of them on a different printed line than A; REQUIRE neigh >= 1 AND fitGapEm < 0.5 where avgChar = (B.x1 - B.x0)/max(1, length of b right-trimmed), chunk = tokR up to its first '-', U+2010 or U+2011 (whole tokR if none or if at index 0), fitGapEm = (blockRight - (A.x1 - 0.33*em + avgChar*chunk.length))/em

predicatesAllRequired.name: pair-never-inline
predicatesAllRequired.test: evidence.pairs[(L + '-' + R) lower-cased] is 0 or absent

action: remove exactly the final U+002D of A (right-trimmed) and append B (left-trimmed) with nothing between; every other character of the page is emitted exactly as v1 emits it
neverJoined: any hyphen-like character other than U+002D
a fragment whose boundary letter is not lower case
non-Latin fragments (Arabic, Persian, Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, mixed script)
rotated or skewed text, or text whose direction is rtl

a break whose left or right white-space-delimited token contains '/', '@', or a '.' or ':' immediately followed by a letter or digit (URL, domain, e-mail, DOI, scheme:identifier), or a left token with a digit or a second hyphen
a next line that is not directly below within the same column (column change, footer, caption, table cell row change)
a line that does not reach the right edge of its block
a word whose joined form is not written inline elsewhere in the same extraction, or whose hyphenated pair is written inline anywhere
any format other than PDF; any already-extracted stored text
clarificationsOfDecisionProse: direction: the measured predicate is 'not rtl' (DECISION.md says dir = ltr)
vertical clause above 2.6 em: the measured predicate requires the gap to be within 25% of the page pitch on both sides (DECISION.md says 'at most 1.25 x the pitch')
fragment width: the measured predicate uses the first token of B up to its first hyphen, trailing punctuation included (DECISION.md says 'B's first fragment')
the previous-segment exclusion in the evidence is applied within a page only
geometry is rounded as stated under 'rounding'
onlyDifferenceFromRuleB: predicate 7b (whole-token URL / domain / address restriction). Every other definition, predicate and threshold is copied unchanged.

appliesTo: tokL: the last white-space-delimited token of segment A, right-trimmed, including its final hyphen
tokR: the first white-space-delimited token of segment B, left-trimmed, in full (not only the fragment R)
meaning: the token contains U+002F SOLIDUS (this covers '://', URL paths, 'doi.org/10.x/y', 'a/b')
the token contains U+0040 COMMERCIAL AT
the token contains U+002E FULL STOP immediately followed by a letter (\p{L}) or a digit (\p{N})
the token contains U+003A COLON immediately followed by a letter or a digit
notRejected: a full stop, colon, comma, semicolon, bracket or quote at the END of the token or followed by other punctuation ('word.', 'word:', 'word.)', 'word.”')
an apostrophe followed by letters (aujourd’hui, government’s)
any character other than the four listed
urlStructure.asciiOnly: only U+002F, U+0040, U+002E and U+003A are tested; full-width or other look-alike characters are not
urlStructure.whyWholeToken: Rule B's predicate 7 inspects only the character that follows the right fragment and allows '.' and ':' there, so 'ps://doi.org/...' and 'zin.de' passed. Predicate 6 already confines the left token to opening punctuation, letters and the final hyphen, so in practice 7b can only fire on the right token; it is stated for both tokens so that the property does not depend on predicate 6.

orderedPseudocode: EVIDENCE (built once from the ORIGINAL segments of all extracted pages; never updated by any decision)
for each segment S on each page:
body = lowercase(S.text)
if rtrim(S.text) ends with <letter run><hyphen-like>:   remove the last white-space token of body
if the previous segment ON THIS PAGE ends that way:     remove the first white-space token of body
for each match of \p{L}+(?:[-\u2010\u2011]\p{L}+)* in body:
split at '-', U+2010, U+2011; WORDS[part] += 1 for every part; PAIRS[part_k + '-' + part_(k+1)] += 1
FOR each pair of consecutive segments A, B in pdf.js emission order:
a = rtrim(A.text); b = ltrim(B.text)
(L, hy) = match of (\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*)(hyphen-like)$ in a        else: no join
R       = match of ^(\p{L}[\p{L}\p{M}]*) in b                     else: no join
tokL = last white-space token of a; tokR = first white-space token of b; em = max(A.lastEm or A.em, 1)
JOIN only if ALL hold, tested in this order:
1  A and B are on the same page
2  hy is U+002D
3  last character of L is \p{Ll} and first character of R is \p{Ll}
4  L and R each match ^[\p{Script=Latin}\p{M}]+$
5  length(L) >= 2 and length(R) >= 2
7b neither tokL nor tokR matches [/@]|[.:][\p{L}\p{N}]
8  A.rot and B.rot are false; A.lastDir != 'rtl'; B.firstDir != 'rtl'
9  d = round2((A.y - B.y)/em);  d > 0.5 and d <= 4 and ( d <= 2.6 or ( pitch != null and round2(|A.y - B.y - pitch|/pitch) <= 0.25 ) )
10  x = round2((gx0(B) - gx0(A))/em);  -6 <= x <= 3  and  gx0(B) < A.x1
11  r = round2((B.firstEm or B.em)/em);  0.70 <= r <= 1.45
12  N = segments j in i-6..i+6 of the page, not rot, |gx0(j) - gx0(A)| <= 3*em and |y_j - A.y| <= 10*em (A included);
at least one member of N is on another printed line than A; blockRight = max gx1 over N;
chunk = tokR up to its first '-', U+2010 or U+2011 (whole tokR if none or if at index 0);
round2((blockRight - (A.x1 - 0.33*em + ((B.x1 - B.x0)/max(1, length(rtrim(b)))) * length(chunk)))/em) < 0.5
13  WORDS[lowercase(L + R)] >= 1
14  PAIRS[lowercase(L + '-' + R)] is 0 or absent
ACTION: remove exactly the final U+002D of a and append b with nothing between; emit every other character as v1 does
segment geometry (x0, x1, y, em, firstEm, lastEm) is rounded to 0.1 unit when the segment is built; round2 = round to 2 decimals
